summary: 39-year-old Grand Junction kayaker swept into a strainer and drowned on the Crystal River after his boat flipped while leading a kayaking group; his body went unfound for nearly two months until two Crested Butte kayakers, searching at the Gunnison County Sheriff's request, spotted the remains hung up on a bridge divider near Highway 133.
location: Crystal River near Highway 133 bridge, ~4 miles south of the Gunnison/Pitkin county line
responding_agency: Gunnison County Sheriff's Office; Crested Butte Recovery Team (swift-water); Carbondale Fire Department
notes: Incident (drowning) 2014-05-31. Remains located 2014-07-26 ~2:45 p.m. by Milo Wynne and Scotty Mann after a ~4-hr kayak search; victim identified via Grand Junction Pathology as Uriah Shaffer. Recovery conducted by the Crested Butte Recovery Team and Carbondale Fire Department swift-water members; body taken to Grand Junction.
